# LOKIO

> The map where people nearby actually talk.

LOKIO is a location-based social app. Users drop pins on a map — a joke, a thought, a plan. Anyone within walking distance sees the pin, opens the chat, and replies. If it clicks, they meet. Everything disappears within 24 hours.

## What LOKIO Is

- A map-based social platform where every post is a pin tied to a physical location
- Each pin is a chatroom — up to 50 people can join if they're within range
- All content is ephemeral: pins live 6–24 hours, then disappear with their chats
- No feed, no followers, no likes, no DMs, no algorithm
- Anonymous by default: name + gender tag minimum, links optional
- Free, works in any browser at app.lokio.org — no install required
- Available in English and Russian

## Core Loop

1. **Drop** — Post a pin: a joke, an observation, an invitation, a question. One line, 5 seconds.
2. **Open** — The pin becomes a chatroom. People nearby tap in and reply.
3. **Meet** — If plans form, people meet in real life. The chat archives itself after.

## What Makes LOKIO Different

- **No global feed.** You only see pins within walking distance (~500m). The map ends where you can't reach in 15 minutes.
- **No followers.** You don't collect people. After a chat closes, the only thing you keep is the memory.
- **No DMs.** Conversation lives on the pin, visible to everyone in range. Safety by transparency.
- **Ephemeral.** Nothing persists. No post history, no archives, no digital footprint. This removes the fear of posting.
- **Zero barrier entry.** The entry point is humor and curiosity, not commitment. "It's hot, who else is melting?" is a valid pin.

## Use Cases

- Spontaneous meetups ("free pizza at the office", "who wants to grab coffee")
- Finding people nearby ("just moved here, looking for hiking partners")
- Local discoveries ("bakery giving away leftovers after 9pm")
- Creative collaboration ("looking for a guitarist for a jam session Saturday")
- Language exchange ("tandem partner, my Russian for your German")
- Casual gigs ("help with moving, 4 hours, same-day pay")
- Travel ("just landed, where to get a SIM card around here?")

## Business Model

- Free baseline for all users — always
- Paid boosts: extend pin radius, increase TTL, add visual banner
- Boost pricing: 1 day $2 / 7 days $10 / 30 days $25 (× city coefficient)
- Monthly subscription for frequent posters: $30/month
- Zero gamification, zero ads, zero data sales
- Users are not the product. Revenue comes from pin boosts.

## Profile / Digital Business Card

Every user gets a public page at lokio.org/u/{username} — a free Linktree-style digital business card with links, bio, and verified accounts. Shareable anywhere: Instagram bio, Telegram, physical business cards. Viewable without registration.

## Safety Architecture

- Pins are ephemeral — disappear automatically
- Reports require phone verification (1 SIM = 1 reporter identity)
- Reports are public — the target sees who reported
- Auto-shadow-ban: 3+ verified reports in 30 days → 7-day shadow ban
- 3 shadow bans in 6 months → permanent ban
- No DMs — all conversation is public on the pin
- 18+ age gate at registration

## Technical Stack

- PWA (Progressive Web App) — works in any mobile browser
- React 18 + Vite (frontend)
- Fastify + Prisma + PostgreSQL + Redis (backend)
- WebAuthn passkeys for authentication
- Cloudflare Pages (frontend hosting)
- Railway (backend hosting)
- Native iOS/Android apps planned after traction
